Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misread and adopted “1968 (USA)” from a search results snippet/knowledge panel as the film’s release year without verifying the IMDb page or cross-checking reputable sources, and dismissed the 1960 UK release noted by Wikipedia. The task requires the earliest theatrical release, for which Moment of Danger is 1960 (UK), not 1968; this misinterpretation would lead to the wrong comparative outcome against The Ballad of Josie (1967).
